title: VendPoint Start-Up Return Unit Credit — Calculation
content:
Calculation of the start-up unit credit for an unused unit of the item most recently added to a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine, returned into the machine during its start-up months.

**The item.** The item most recently added is the item whose add entry on the machine's selection history carries the highest planogram request reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence).

**The price.** The item's latest vend is its vend carrying the highest vend transaction number (the machine log numbers vends in sequence). The price the credit is figured from is the unit price of the item's latest vend, the price paid for the returned units, whatever the item's contract price line says today; an item with no vend on the machine has no unit to return and no credit.

**The standard unit credit.** The standard unit credit is the unit price of the item's latest vend, the price paid for the returned units, rounded half up to the cent.

**The start-up unit credit.** To fix the start-up unit credit, each method that applies first replaces the quantity of the standard unit credit it names, so that a charge a method subtracts comes before any share; each share that applies then multiplies the figure, and the product is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

### Hypothetical worked figures

| Latest vend unit price | Today's contract price line | Standard unit credit |
|---|---|---|
| 12.3450 USD | 13.0000 USD | 12.35 USD (12.3450 rounded half up to the cent; today's price line does not enter) |
| 4.1240 USD | 4.1240 USD | 4.12 USD |
| no vend of the item on the machine | any | no credit |

The prices are invented for illustration.
